meta.title: Crypto Asset Identification | Lenix Protocol
meta.description: Locate, trace, and document cryptocurrency holdings for litigation, estate, and enforcement matters. Forensic methodology with clear scope and deliverables.

Hero.subtitle: For attorneys, investigators, and financial professionals who need to locate, trace, and verify cryptocurrency in litigation, estate matters, and enforcement — using methodology designed to hold up under review.

Audiences.title: Matters we commonly support
Audiences.description: Identification work is scoped to authorized legal, regulatory, or corporate investigations — not open-ended searches on unrelated parties.

family.title: Family law and divorce
family.desc: Asset division where one party may have undeclared wallets, exchange accounts, or on-chain holdings not reflected in financial disclosures.

fraud.title: Fraud and embezzlement
fraud.desc: Civil or criminal matters involving misappropriated digital funds — tracing movement from known source wallets or compromised accounts.

estate.title: Estate and probate
estate.desc: Executors or counsel locating cryptocurrency a decedent held but did not document — starting from devices, records, or partial address leads.

enforcement.title: Bankruptcy and enforcement
enforcement.desc: Judgment creditors, trustees, or regulators identifying attachable crypto assets and exchange touchpoints relevant to a debtor or subject.

Methods.title: Identification and analysis scope
Methods.description: Work combines on-chain analysis with corroborating evidence from the matter — not blockchain lookups in isolation.

linkage.title: Wallet identification
linkage.desc: Link blockchain addresses to subjects using transaction patterns, clustering, and cross-reference with device, financial, or testimony evidence.

flows.title: Transaction flow analysis
flows.desc: Follow fund movement across chains and layers — including visible mixer use, bridge transfers, and consolidation points worth documenting.

attribution.title: Exchange and NFT attribution
attribution.desc: Identify likely custodial deposits, off-ramps, and NFT holdings tied to the matter when on-chain data and supporting leads allow.

Boundaries.subtitle: Public blockchain data has limits. Lenix scopes each engagement to lawful access, available leads, and what can be supported in a report.

legal_basis.title: Authorized matters only
legal_basis.desc: We take cases with a legal, regulatory, or corporate investigation basis — not speculative tracing of unrelated individuals or addresses.

chain_limits.title: On-chain is not the full picture
chain_limits.desc: Exchange balances held in custodial accounts or undeclared cold storage may require separate legal process beyond public ledger analysis.

evidence.title: Forensic integrity
evidence.desc: Methods and data handling are documented for counsel review, regulatory settings, or court — with chain of custody preserved.

neutral.title: Neutral capacity available
neutral.desc: Lenix can support plaintiff counsel, defense, or serve as an independent expert in asset division and valuation disputes.

no_guarantee.title: No completeness guarantee
no_guarantee.desc: Identification is bounded by leads provided, chain visibility, and lawful access. We state what is and is not recoverable from available data.

disclosure.title: Controlled disclosure
disclosure.desc: Findings are shared only with parties authorized under the engagement — not broadcast or used outside the defined matter scope.

Process.title: From intake to documented findings
Process.description: A structured path for counsel and investigators — scoped before analysis begins.

intake.title: Define matter scope
intake.desc: Case type, parties, known wallet addresses, device or financial records, and what questions identification needs to answer.

trace.title: Trace and analyze
trace.desc: Wallet linkage, flow mapping, and exchange touchpoint analysis using on-chain data cross-referenced with matter evidence.

report.title: Deliver findings
report.desc: Written analysis with timelines and methodology section — suitable for litigation strategy, compliance, or further legal process.

Deliverables.title: Outputs built for legal and compliance use
Deliverables.description: Deliverables are tailored to the matter — not generic blockchain screenshots.

timeline.title: Transaction chronology
timeline.desc: Dated flow of relevant movements with wallet linkage maps showing how identified addresses connect to the subject matter.

report.title: Written analysis
report.desc: Methodology, findings, and limitations documented for counsel review — with clear separation of fact and inference.

testimony.title: Expert support
testimony.desc: Expert testimony or supplemental analysis available where jurisdiction, engagement terms, and case needs require it.

Cta.title: Need to locate undisclosed crypto in a matter?
Cta.subtitle: Share the case context and leads you already have. We will outline what identification work is realistic before scoped engagement.
